run.label: rider-fix-retest
run.note: 21-Nov-2026 07.13-07.47 IST on test.gokesari.com, in delivery hours: re-test of E-38 / E-39 / E-40 with PR #445's suite. Delivery TC-DEL-001/010/012/020 and the support file at 07.13-07.37 (suite 4ff18be6); the returns file again at 07.42-07.47 with the E-41 fix (5852a2ea), whose rows replace the first run's. Phone TC-RET-001 / TC-FLD-095 count their 07.28 pass: their 07.47 re-run was blocked only by customer 1's wallet (Rs 1,188.50, HTTP 402).
